terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D object-space terms and evidence refs.

referenceCamera.note: Front, side and back orthographic-like views are available; perspective and hidden hinge stops remain inferred.

objectClass.notes: Four archived runtime views conditionally establish the exterior. They are not GPT Image 2 output. The visual rebuild preserves all archived animation anchors.

reasoning: Low rectangular base plus hinged lid, platter/tonearm mechanism, grille repetition, rear hardware, and a visible playback animation make this a complex compound appliance.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Compound articulated assembly with radial repetition and mixed transparency.

detailInventory.note: Every identity-defining detail is linked to a component or material override below.

details.description: Cream rounded base shell with softened front and side corners.
Raised transparent lid frame with inset inner panel.
Two pink rear hinge blocks and barrel pins.
Dark circular platter with thin pink perimeter band.
Central spindle pin and concentric record label ring.
Bent cream tonearm rooted at rear-right pivot.
Pink rectangular cartridge at stylus end.
Dense horizontal pink slat field across front panel.
Pink cylindrical speed/volume knob on top-right.
Centered recessed carry handle with two pink mounts.
Pink rear I/O plate with two circular sockets.
Four separate dark-pink rubber feet under shell.
Small power indicator beside control area.
Two six-sided Sakura side cheeks break the rectangular base silhouette.
Three concentric low-poly vinyl grooves reinforce record rotation.
Eight-sided pink tonearm counterweight remains attached to the cue pivot.
Octagonal speaker badge and pulse ring interrupt the uniform front slat field.

definitionOfDone: The v2 record player reads as a more exaggerated faceted SAKURA game prop while its archived package, platter/tonearm mechanics, effect origin and exact reset contract remain unchanged.

featureGroups.name: Rounded shell proportion
qualityCriteria: Height/width 1.12 and depth/width 0.72 with broad corner radii.

featureGroups.name: Platter and tonearm mechanism
qualityCriteria: Platter, center spindle, tonearm pivot, cartridge and stylus remain independently named around the playback axis.
failureModes: fused platter/tonearm parts or off-axis spindle

featureGroups.name: Front speaker grille
qualityCriteria: Eleven horizontal pink slats remain raised inside a dark recessed front cavity.
failureModes: flat grille decal or wrong slat rhythm

featureGroups.name: Rear hinges, carry handle and I/O plate
qualityCriteria: Two hinges, centered recessed handle and two circular sockets remain readable from the back.
failureModes: missing rear hardware or fused handle

featureGroups.name: Powered purpose animation
qualityCriteria: Control turns, platter spins and tonearm cues while the status light activates, then all transforms reset at 5.2 seconds.
failureModes: generic wobble without recognizable record playback

featureGroups.name: Stable irregular ink hierarchy
qualityCriteria: Main 0.0048, structure 0.0041 and detail 0.0033 use stable object-space variation 0.18.
Transparent lid and volumetric music effects have no visible hull outlines.

antiShallowSpecRules: No flat texture replacement for platter, tonearm or grille.

right-rear tonearm, counterweight, cartridge and stylus under frozen pivots
front eleven-slat grille with speaker pulse badge

exact archived animation anchors and music effect center

lightingFromPhoto: warm upper-left key separating cream and pink Toon bands
cool violet lower fill defining faceted side cheeks
soft pink rear rim around lid and tonearm
pale blue-gray background with contact shadow
transparent lid excluded from thick outline
proceduralStrategy: Block out the low suitcase shell and raised lid first.
Separate platter, tonearm, cartridge, grille slats, hinges, handle and I/O plate into named components.
Use stable pivots for lid hinge, platter spindle, tonearm cue and control knob; expose power socket and stylus sockets.
Use independent pastel PBR materials and transparent lid depth-write disabled.
Animate power as a recognizable platter spin, tonearm cueing and status-light pulse.
animationAnchors: lid-hinge-pivot rotates around rear hinge axis
tonearm-pivot sweeps stylus over platter with cartridge socket
power-connection-socket anchors cable and start signal
destructionAnchors: lid and hinge pair form one detachable shell group
front grille slat array remains a separate breakable group
platter/tonearm assembly can detach from body shell without fusing visual meshes
risks: The low-poly v2 is deliberately more angular than the soft v1 archive.
The transparent lid can soften internal borders under some view angles.
Dense climax effects can partially obscure the enlarged platter and tonearm.
